Any in Waterfalls |season = Fall |weather = Any |difficulty = 50 |behavior = Mixed |size = 24-66 |price = 75 |edibility = 15 |roe = Light Red }} The '''Salmon''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the river (in [[Pelican Town]] or [[Cindersap Forest]]) during [[Fall]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It may also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Fall, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|75}}. It can be caught in the waterfalls in southern [[Cindersap Forest]] during Fall at any time. Salmon can be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]]. ==Map== The Salmon can be found in the river. {{Map|200|150|loc2x=120|loc2y=150}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Maru,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Krobus |neutral=Demetrius,Sebastian,Linus,Pam,Elliott,Willy,Leo |hate=Pierre,Evelyn,Haley }} ==Bundles== The Salmon is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header|hide=buff,duration}} {{:Maki Roll|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Quality Fertilizer|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Salmon Dinner|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{:Sashimi|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Salmon is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Faded Denim Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt279.png|24px]] It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located in [[Haley]]'s and [[Emily]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Fish Pond== Salmon can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The only possible output is light red Salmon [[Roe]].
